# Annetta Bell & Nell Harcourt

- [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — Mentor of — [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) — pupil in Nell's schoolroom · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dismisses school early as a monstrous storm approaches, exactly as [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) predicted. She rushes home with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where they shelter with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) through a terrifying 45-minute hail storm that devastates crops and shatters windows. Afterward, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) arrives to report that lightning struck Mr. Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer comfort.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_
